hook: your whole marketing department is you, in the truck, between jobs.
caption:
Small business marketing from your phone: the 4 minute version for busy owners

If you run a service business (plumbing, cleaning, tile, landscaping, detailing) you don't have a marketing hour. This is the small business marketing routine that fits between jobs: one photo of today's job, a first line about what the customer was worried about, post it, then reply to yesterday's comments. Three times a week is enough to stay visible to local customers.

Want the plan sent to your phone each week? Text us a reel you liked, link in bio.
